title: FPS Shooting Game
physics_constraints: player movement: 8 units/s, WASD relative to camera facing
wall collision: raycaster-based, distance ~1.0, blocks movement
shooting: raycaster from camera center, range 50 units, 25 damage per hit
ammo: 30 per clip, R to reload, 2s reload time, no shooting while reloading
enemy AI: rotate toward player, move at 1.5 units/s when within 30 units
enemy HP: 100, dead at HP<=0, turns gray and falls over
difficulty_analysis: L5 Challenges: (1) Building a multi-room arena with connecting doorways; (2) Collision detection for PointerLockControls + WASD movement; (3) Raycast shooting system: casting from the camera center, range limiting, and hit detection; (4) Ammunition management and reload state machine; (5) Enemy AI (orientation, pursuit, and distance checks); (6) HP bar billboard effect; (7) Death animation and state management; (8) Complete HUD synchronization
